flags: Release -O3 -DNDEBUG, arm64 NEON, no explicit -march, baseline convolution kernels, sanitizers off
scope: Experimental ordered-transform adapter only, outside repository production targets. Not a shipped backend; no Linux or Windows execution.
method: All 2 order permutations repeated twice, same workloads as preceding comparisons; new Ooura controls. FFT sizes in timed production layout: 128, 512, 2048, 8192, 16384.
tiny_transform_policy: Native engine oracle exercises custom N=8, unsupported by SIMD PFFFT. Adapter uses existing Ooura for N<32; timed workloads use PFFFT throughout.
prototype_limits: Uses conservative resource allowance; full package exports, symbol visibility, all-C-allocation interception and host qualification not performed. Build bootstrap uses OOURA then replaces target source: configure label is OOURA, but binary and CSV report PFFFT-experimental. Existing native.engine allocation guard intercepts C++ new, not every C allocator; the PFFFT no-allocation execution claim also relies on its API/source contract.
build_adapter: cmake --build pffft-convolver --target convolver_backend_benchmark convolver_fft_tests convolver_engine_tests convolver_cli --parallel 4
reproduction: Clone pinned PFFFT in the scratch directory. Write harness files below; substitute scratch paths in CMake. Reuse the pinned Convolver source and callback wrapper in the preceding FFT run record. Build library, then adapter and tests, then run driver. No engine source edits.
cmake_wrapper:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "14.0" CACHE STRING "Deployment target")
project(ConvolverPffftSpike LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
set(ROOT "/Users/jrp/perf2-backends")
add_subdirectory("${ROOT}/source" convolver)
# Replace the backend only in this scratch target, leaving source untouched.
get_target_property(core_sources convolver_core SOURCES)
list(FILTER core_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "fft_ooura.cpp")
set_property(TARGET convolver_core PROPERTY SOURCES "${core_sources}")
target_sources(convolver_core PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/fft_pffft.cpp")
target_include_directories(convolver_core PRIVATE "${ROOT}/source/portable")
add_library(pffft_spike STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(pffft_spike PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../pffft-build/libpffft.a"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../pffft/include"
    INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "PFFFT_STATIC_DEFINE")
target_link_libraries(convolver_core PRIVATE pffft_spike)
add_executable(convolver_backend_benchmark "${ROOT}/harness/callback_backend.cpp")
target_compile_features(convolver_backend_benchmark PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(convolver_backend_benchmark PRIVATE "${ROOT}/source/portable")
target_link_libraries(convolver_backend_benchmark PRIVATE convolver_core convolver_host convolver_io)
